'''Susanoo Jinja''' (素盞嗚神社、素戔嗚神社、素盞鳴神社、素戔鳴神社、須佐之男神社) is a Shinto shrine dedicated to {{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō|1=Gozu Tennō}} and {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|en|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto|1=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, central deities in {{ill|Gion cult|en|Gion cult|qid=Q11588425|lt=Gion Faith|1=Gion Faith}}. Such shrines are located throughout Japan. Variations in the name include using "戔" instead of "盞" for the second character and "鳴 (with the bird radical)" instead of "嗚 (with the crow radical)" for the third character. Other shrines associated with Gion Faith include {{ill|Yasaka Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|八坂神社 (曖昧さ回避)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine (disambiguation)}}, {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrines|qid=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine|en|Hiromine Shrine|qid=Q11484399|lt=Hiromine Shrine|1=Hiromine Shrine}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenno Shrine}}, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391847}}, and {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine}}, which vary in usage across periods and sources.

Susanoo may also be written as 素盞雄, 須佐男, 須佐之男, 進雄, or 素盞雄, often with the addition of "命" (Mikoto) or "尊."

Until the Edo period, these shrines were generally referred to as '''Gozu Tennōsha''', venerating {{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō|1=Gozu Tennō}}. Their main shrines are located in Kyoto at {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|en|Yasaka Shrine|qid=Q692714|lt=Yasaka Shrine|1=Yasaka Shrine}} or in Hyōgo Prefecture at {{ill|Hiromine Shrine|en|Hiromine Shrine|qid=Q11484399|lt=Hiromine Shrine|1=Hiromine Shrine}}.
